experience: Asked to change how T3 Code itself looks, an agent reads the theme guide, then proposes a colors-only theme with t3_theme_propose. It does not write theme files, settings or CSS.
rule: t3_theme_propose: Propose a look for T3 Code itself, only when the user asks. Colors only.

source.note: Ported to the multi-user Hub as a proposal each viewer applies in their own browser.

t3_theme_read.guide: Propose a new look for T3 Code with `t3_theme_propose`. A proposal is colors only: `name`, `appearance` (light or dark), `canvas` and `accent` as #rrggbb.

t3_theme_propose.next: Shown to the user as a card in this thread.

prompt: Make T3 Code itself look like a late-night terminal: near-black background with a green accent.

pattern: ordinary task: edit the project's own theme
experience: The user's project has a theme of its own. A request to change it is a file edit. No T3 Code theme is proposed.
rule: t3_theme_propose: Propose a look for T3 Code itself, only when the user asks.
prompt: In src/theme.css, change the dark theme accent to green.
